_doc: STD-SLOT-HOLDS-CON corrections (runbook §59). Each cell's stored STANDALONE PAT was the CONSOLIDATED figure. Correcting a non-null value -> runbook §2b procedure, NOT a fill. The con slot is CORRECT in every case here and is left untouched. Applier: scripts/stdcon_audit/apply_fixes.py (guard-edits sf_fundamentals.json + scripts/fundamentals.json idx1, sf_revop.json + scripts/revop_fundamentals.json idx4).

_identities.LICI-FY2024-std: 9543.71 + 7925.02 + 9444.42 + 13762.64 = 40675.79 == the FY24 standalone annual printed in the 27-May-2024 filing (p4). Stored quarters sum to 40872.32.
_identities.LICI-FY2022-Q4-std: FY22 annual 4043.12 - 9M FY22 1671.57 = 2371.55. The same subtraction on the CON side, 4124.71 - 1715.31 = 2409.40, reproduces the value we currently store in the std slot - i.e. the stored number is demonstrably the consolidated one.
_identities.LICI-H1FY26-std: 10053.39 + 10986.51 = 21039.90 == the printed H1FY26 standalone total (06-Nov-2025 filing p4). The con side: 10098.48 + 10957.05 = 21055.53 == the printed H1FY26 consolidated total.
